run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable function and print average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_with_iterations: test time_func by passing a custom number of iterations to benchmark a function
test_time_func_with_name: test time_func by passing a custom name label for the benchmark output
review_time_func_warmup: review time_func to understand its warmup phase before measuring performance
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which benchmarks a function using perf_counter and prints average ms per call
